verdict.rationale: Pigment's own marketing says data can be integrated through 'open APIs' (docs-7), and it documents an Audit Trail API (docs-13). The Audit Trail API only feeds security and log events to a SIEM; it is not a way to drive the product, and no OpenAPI spec was found at any probed path (probe-3). The MCP server belongs to a separate story and is not credited here. Missing for 10: API reference documentation, endpoints for reading and writing model data or triggering actions, an OpenAPI/machine-readable spec, auth and usage docs, and hands-on corroboration.
